directions.name: A - Enchanted ink
directions.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: raster art-direction contact sheet for Studioodle, a free family coloring studio. This is an exploration of a NEW custom UI icon family, not a screenshot of the app.
Primary request: Direction A, "Enchanted ink": magical, playful and zen, beautifully clear, warm and inviting. Six bespoke line-art icons with gentle asymmetry, rounded expressive curves and generous open space. Calm storybook ink, simple confident soft cream outlines, tiny restrained antique-gold or muted-teal accents. A little life and one or two purposeful four-point sparks across the whole set, not glitter on every icon. Not industrial, not rigid geometric stock icons.
Composition: landscape contact sheet, precisely THREE columns and TWO rows, equal generous spacing. In reading order show: (1) an OPEN book with softly curved asymmetric pages and a small PLUS clearly OUTSIDE its upper-right corner; (2) a friendly artist's brush with a curved handle and simple bristle tip; (3) a small tipped paint bucket pouring ONE solid paint drop; (4) two overlapping peelable sticker sheets, the front with one simple star and a visibly curled corner; (5) a curved artist's palette with three generous color wells; (6) a clear sweeping UNDO arrow pointing left, relaxed and slightly whimsical.
Each cell shows its large icon above TWO small preview buttons, the identical icon on a warm-ivory rounded-square button and on a deep-navy rounded-square button. Small previews must retain clear silhouettes with few strokes. One consistent visual weight across all six controls.
Color palette: deep navy presentation background #142238, warm ivory #f6f0e2, muted gold #ddc799, quiet teal #5b9b98; only tiny restrained color-well accents. Flat drawn line art, no glossy surfaces, no photorealism, no heavy shadows, no gradients in the icons, no decorative border.
Constraints: all six functions must be recognizable as buttons at about 26–32px; no tiny filigree, no ornate fantasy weapons, no faces or mascots, no medical or religious book imagery, no closed book, no cross printed on a cover. No text, labels, letters, numerals, watermark or logo anywhere. The book pages, peel corner and undo gesture should carry the personality without extra clutter.

directions.name: B - Paper charms
directions.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: raster art-direction contact sheet for a NEW custom icon family for Studioodle, a magical, fun, zen family coloring studio. Exploration only, not an app screenshot.
Primary request: Direction B, "Paper charms": six simple, inviting little cut-paper emblems, like a beautifully made storybook craft kit. Soft matte paper shapes, gently irregular curves, slightly asymmetric folds, warm ivory paper with muted teal, butter-gold and tiny coral accents, dark blue-green contour accents where needed. Very shallow paper layering and barely perceptible soft contact shadows only. Friendly tactile calm; not industrial, not glossy plastic, not toy-like 3D, not ornate fantasy collectibles.
Composition: a deep-navy landscape contact sheet with EXACTLY six cells in THREE columns and TWO rows. Reading order: (1) an OPEN coloring book with curved asymmetric paper pages, a small gold PLUS outside its upper-right corner and one restrained spark; (2) a simple artist brush with a curved wooden/paper handle, broad bristle tip and a small teal paint accent; (3) a friendly rounded bucket tipped to pour one solid color drop; (4) two overlapping sticker sheets, front sheet with one star and a generously curled peel corner; (5) a soft curved artist palette with three large color wells; (6) a wide, clear UNDO arrow sweeping left like a curled paper ribbon.
For each cell put the enlarged icon above two matching small preview buttons: warm-ivory rounded square on the left, deep-navy rounded square on the right. Keep the functional symbol readable in both. Identical perspective and consistent visual weight across all six. This is a coordinated icon family, not six unrelated illustrations.
Palette: navy #142238, paper #f6f0e2, teal #5b9b98, gold #ddc799, minimal soft-coral accents. Broad shapes, minimal internal marks, plenty of negative space, crisp silhouettes. Slight tactile paper material, no busy texture.
Constraints: must plausibly reduce to 26–32px buttons. The small book must clearly be open and its plus must not resemble a cross on a closed cover. A calm magical feeling should come from curves, folds, proportions and limited accent color. No excessive sparkles, glitter, gradients, jewel effects, hard bevels or thick shadows. No faces, characters, mascots or extraneous props. No words, labels, letters, numerals, logos or watermarks anywhere.

directions.name: C - Gentle gesture
directions.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: raster art-direction contact sheet exploring a NEW UI icon family for Studioodle, a magical, fun and zen coloring studio for parents and children.
Primary request: Direction C, "Gentle gesture": remarkably simple soft ink silhouettes with a hand-drawn spirit. Broad, gently tapered shapes and lively asymmetric curves; warm and quietly magical, highly legible, never industrial. Think a calm illustrator's few confident brush gestures translated into clean flat symbols. This direction must be VISIBLY simpler and flatter than detailed storybook outlines or layered paper illustrations.
Composition: deep navy landscape board with exactly SIX equally spaced icons in THREE columns and TWO rows. In reading order: (1) an OPEN book made from just two broad softly curved pages and a clear central negative-space fold, PLUS outside its upper-right corner, one tiny four-point spark; pages have NO pictures, floral motifs, writing or tiny lines; (2) a simple artist brush with a slightly curved handle and one soft bristle shape, tiny teal painted tip; (3) a generously rounded tipped bucket with a clear hollow opening and ONE solid teal drop; (4) two offset sticker tiles, front tile has one bold star cutout and an unmistakable curved peel corner; (5) a softly irregular artist palette with three big simple color wells; (6) one filled, relaxed left-pointing UNDO arrow, a clean sweeping shape with no extra tail, no clock motif.
Each cell shows the enlarged icon with TWO small preview buttons beneath it: the same mark on a warm-ivory rounded square on the left and on a deep-navy rounded square on the right. Small variants should be simplified faithfully, not detailed mini-illustrations. Match visual weight and scale across all six.
Style: FLAT 2D, mostly solid shapes, carefully chosen negative space, at most one or two interior marks per icon. Clean drawn edges with slight organic asymmetry and broad curves. No outlines inside outlines. Use dark teal ink on the light examples and warm ivory ink on the dark examples. Restrained muted-gold and teal accents only where meaningful.
Palette: navy #142238, ivory #f6f0e2, muted teal #5b9b98 and butter gold #ddc799. No textures, paper grain, gradients, shadows, bevels, 3D depth, gloss, glow, glitter or ornamental frames. No faces, mascots or arbitrary extra props. One tiny book spark is enough; no sparkle attached to every tool. Preserve literal tool meanings rather than replacing tools with fantasy objects. No words, labels, letters, numerals, watermarks or logos. Optimize recognizability for eventual 26–32px buttons.
directions.targetedEdit:
Edit the most recent six-icon Studioodle contact sheet (Direction C, flat gentle ink silhouettes). Keep the complete layout, deep-navy background, palette, texture, icon shapes, brush, bucket, sticker sheets, artist palette, undo arrow, and every small preview button unchanged.
Make ONLY this targeted correction: on the OPEN BOOK in the top-left cell, replace the gold four-point sparkle above the upper-right page with a clearly recognizable rounded PLUS sign, two straight perpendicular strokes of equal length. The plus must sit outside the book at the existing badge position. It must read as ADD, never a star or medical/religious mark printed on the pages. Apply the exact same plus correction to BOTH small light and dark book preview buttons below it. Do not change the book itself or any other icon. No words, letters, labels or other additions.
